about: Requests a real browser load of each demo target made that tools/export_prebaked.mjs does not replay (read from performance entries, 15 Nov 2026): the viewer's 'other source' SIMBAD cone, whose brightest-pixel pick in the page differs from the Node replay for these two targets.
